claim: MCP.md still says this release supports only McpProtocol.v2024_11_05, v2025_03_26, and v2025_06_18, and both copy-paste servers pin protocols: [McpProtocol.v2025_06_18].
At a7a71921de McpProtocol.ProtocolVersion is the five-member union including 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28; v2026_07_28 is the only StatelessRuntimeDescriptor.

MCP.md's supported-protocol sentence and examples were not updated for v2025_11_25, v2026_07_28, instructions, prompt titles, or Tool.Strict, all of which exist in source, tests, and unreleased changesets at a7a71921de.

MCP.md prose tells readers to install Logger.layer([Logger.consolePretty({ stderr: true })]), but consolePretty accepts only { colors, formatDate, mode }. The supported stderr path is Layer.succeed(Logger.LogToStderr, true).

layerStdio JSDoc claims handlers receive McpRequestContext and legacy McpServerClient. The 2026-07-28 adapter does not provide McpServerClient; McpServerClient.protocolVersion is StatefulProtocolVersion.

MCP.md elicitation is McpServer.elicit, which requires McpServerClient and calls the reverse elicit RPC. On v2026_07_28 that reverse operation is McpReverseOperationUnsupported. July elicitation is InputRequired plus a client retry.

A v2026_07_28-only server returns method-not-found (HTTP 404) for initialize. MCP.md never mentions server/discover or the removed handshake, so G4 collides with the published getting-started lifecycle.

migration/v3-to-v4.md and the McpServer registerToolkit annotation say parameter validation fails with InvalidParams, unqualified. Wire tests and the #8228 changeset say InvalidParams through 2025-06-18 and isError: true from 2025-11-25 on.

.changeset/pre/mcp-structured-content-object.md says McpServer no longer sends null or array results as structuredContent because MCP requires a JSON object. July tests and the typetest send and accept non-object structuredContent.
McpServer.ts, McpSchema.ts, and McpProtocol.ts have no JSDoc **Example** blocks. Tool.Strict's example is provider JSON-schema mode, not MCP excess-property rejection.

A stdio server on v2026_07_28 is demonstrated by makeMcpStdioHarness calling layerStdio and by v2026_07_28.test.ts exchanging server/discover as newline-delimited JSON-RPC. MCP.md does not show that pin.

layerHttp has no copy-paste example in MCP.md. The in-tree demonstration is makeServerLayer (path /mcp, allowedOrigins, optional instructions) used by the July HTTP conformance suite. layerHttp JSDoc documents POST/202/400/404/405/Origin default-deny and no GET SSE.
Handlers reading McpRequestContext are demonstrated in typetests and in McpServer, ProtocolAdapters, and July metadata tests. MCP.md never names the service.
MRTR elicitation is demonstrated as InputRequired on tools/call and prompts/get, not as McpServer.elicit. The 2026-07-28 changeset is one sentence and does not mention MRTR.
subscriptions/listen is named in v2026_07_28 JSDoc Details and exercised by SubscriptionsTest and mixed-HTTP McpServer tests. MCP.md does not mention subscriptions.

Strict MCP tools are demonstrated in McpServer.test.ts registerToolkit (closed additionalProperties, excess-property InvalidParams, raw JSON Schema dies). The public Tool.Strict JSDoc example is the unrelated provider flag.
Declared handler failures in both error and return modes return isError: true without structuredContent. MCP.md tool samples only show Effect.succeed.

Prompt titles are a typed McpServer.prompt option, changeset-documented, and asserted in PromptsTest. Resource titles exist on McpSchema.Resource but McpServer.resource/registerResource option types omit title, and no test calls McpServer.resource({ title }).
Server instructions are a constructor option, changeset-documented, and returned from both initialize (LifecycleTest) and July server/discover. MCP.md never passes instructions.
McpServer.toolkit JSDoc still says AiToolkit. v4 exports Toolkit.
Migration annotations for layer, layerHttp, layerStdio, and run still illustrate protocols: [McpProtocol.v2025_06_18] only.
The only 2026-07-28 changeset (.changeset/modern-mice-discover.md) is one sentence and does not mention statelessness, server/discover, dropped initialize, MRTR, or subscriptions/listen.
websiteUrl and icons are McpServer constructor options, tested for 2025-11-25 projections, and covered by .changeset/pre/add-mcp-icons.md. MCP.md is silent.

MCP.md is internally consistent as a v2025_06_18 getting-started page: adapter protocols, 2024 HTTP compatibility disclaimer, and McpServer.elicit on a June server all match code. It is the wrong document for building a 2026-07-28 server.

G4 (v2026_07_28 only) cannot be implemented by copying Effect's published MCP.md recipe. Upstream tests show mixed lists and InputRequired instead. That is an implementability challenge to the working assumption, not a missing Effect capability.
